name: 远控智子
description: Give your agent physical eyes and hands: inject keyboard and mouse into a machine that has the Sophon dongle plugged in, and read back what is on its screen.
description_zh: 让你的 Agent 长出实体手眼：操作插着智子硬件棒的机器，注入键鼠，并读回它的屏幕画面。
description_en: Give your agent physical eyes and hands: inject keyboard and mouse into a machine that has the Sophon dongle plugged in, and read back what is on its screen.
author: 网瘾老登干点啥
examples_zh: 看那台机器的屏幕现在是什么
在那台电脑上打开记事本，输入一行字
用远控智子帮我操作插着硬件棒的机器
examples_en: Show me what is on that machine's screen right now
Open Notepad on the other PC and type a line
Use Sophon Remote to drive the machine the dongle is plugged into
